I grow sorghum on this small plot because it does well even when the rains are not so good, and I do not have money to buy fertilizer for it when my maize plots need it more. I will use the seed I kept from last year's harvest and work the land with my family — my wife and children help with planting and weeding, so we do not need to hire ganyu workers. The rains here in Zomba are enough for sorghum, so I will not irrigate, and I see no reason to spray chemicals on a food crop like this.
